company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. (“NMG“ or the “Company”)".

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies the CEO of the buyer, NMG: "Eric Desaulniers, Founder, President and CEO of NMG, said..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states: "NMG has agreed to acquire 100% of Mason’s Lac Guéret Property".

primary_commodity.justification: The headline of the article states: "NMG Acquires Mason Resources’ Lac Guéret Graphite Deposit/Uatnan Mining Project".

verified_article_link.justification: No article URL was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The cash payment is denoted with a '$' symbol. The economic highlights table clarifies the currency for costs: "All costs are in Canadian dollars with the exception of the graphite sale price which is provided in US dollars." A payment is considered a cost.

option_payments_raw.justification: No mention of options in the transaction terms.
